authorization: Implement the bounded Windows path and raw PTY test-harness fixes. No IPC, manifest, dependency, or lockfile changes. No local Cargo check/test/build/clippy, push, or new CI before independent review and Regente decision.

findings: workspace_root_uses_configured_absolute_directory and cwd_accepts_workspace_and_nested_directories returned workspace path cannot be inspected on Windows.
real_powershell_pty_reads_writes_resizes_and_closes did not observe its real output marker.
normal_powershell_exit_is_reported_as_exited_not_failed timed out before observing process exit.
closing_session_kills_a_descendant_process_in_the_job did not observe the child PID file.
two_real_sessions_keep_input_and_output_independent did not observe both real output markers.
source_ci.other_jobs: Node 24 frontend and eight governance checks passed; clippy, Tauri build, and native smoke were skipped.

changes: Skip filesystem metadata inspection while a Windows path contains only an incomplete drive prefix; inspect the root and every subsequent component once the path is absolute.
Add a regression for inspecting canonical workspace-root components while preserving traversal, UNC/device, reserved-name, and reparse-point rejection tests.

Add a Windows-only raw PTY test harness that responds to CSI 6 n through session input and requires an observed, answered startup query within one second before sending commands; startup, exit, and PID timeout failures include bounded raw diagnostics.
Keep real PowerShell output, process exit, descendant PID/termination, session-independence, and anti-echo assertions active; production PTY and IPC behavior are unchanged.
Compile the process-running diagnostic helper only for Windows tests, where it is used.
